shared_elements: tall upright stone slab/monolith, taller than wide
incised/carved linear decoration on a single principal face
circular or ring motif in the upper-central zone
roughly bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
a rounded/looped element above a broader tapering element below
justification: Both are tall, vertically oriented stone monoliths with roughly symmetrical carved motifs organised about a central axis, and each contains a prominent ring or disc form in the upper-middle field above broader curving bands. Beyond that generic correspondence they differ fundamentally: A is a three-dimensional sculpted figure with a modelled head and shoulders bearing deep, worn relief motifs, while B is a flat, unshaped plaque bearing a single crisp, shallow, red-lined geometric interlace with a stem-like pendant, a wholly abstract and draughtsman-like manner.
